key_highlights: ASX slumps on oil-driven inflation fears and bond yield spike; fourth RBA rate hike looms
Mortgage stress hits 18-year highs; house prices forecast to fall 10% as rate cycle tightens
Australia narrowly avoids recession but productivity 'bad to worse'; per capita recession risk elevated
Coal sector booms; Premier urges Chinese/Indian coal firms to merge before funding stops
Multiple WA/Qld gold discoveries (Gateway, King River, Moonlight, PLC) support junior miners
Sydney mega-developer Bathla warns of imminent collapse — Australia's 'Evergrande moment'
Qantas ground crews vote for right to strike amid pay dispute
Iran-US tensions escalate, pressuring global risk assets and oil prices

sectors.trend: Coal boom and multiple gold discoveries (Gateway Wiluna, King River 44g/t, Moonlight Qld, PLC Murchison) provide sector support; tungsten (Viking) and copper (True North) exploration active. However, Chinese solar overtaking coal (#46) signals medium-term structural risk for thermal coal.
sectors.implications: Short-term tailwind for BHP.AX, FMG.AX, WBC.AX on coal strength; gold juniors (GWN.AX, KRG.AX, MNL.AX) attract speculative flows. Long-term coal exposure faces decarbonisation headwinds.

sectors.trend: Mortgage stress at 18-year highs and potential 10% house price decline threaten NPLs. CBA fee controversy (#58) dents consumer confidence. RBA rate hike fears pressure net interest margins vs credit losses.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face rising credit-cost provisions; REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) vulnerable to higher borrowing costs. Defensive dividend yield still attractive but capital preservation at risk.

sectors.trend: Oil price spike from Iran-US tensions fuels inflation and rate-hike fears. Coal boom supports WBC.AX, BHP.AX thermal coal segment. LNG remains stable.
sectors.implications: Short-term energy outperformance; but oil-driven inflation triggers RBA tightening, creating a negative feedback loop for rate-sensitive sectors.

sectors.trend: Housing 'bloodbath' narrative; Bathla developer near collapse; mortgage stress at 18-year peak. EV purchases replacing overseas travel signal consumer squeeze. Housing affordability crisis intensifies.
sectors.implications: REITs and property developers (SRG.AX, DVH.AX, CGP.AX) under severe stress. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) may see defensive rotation but volume pressure from squeezed households.

sectors.trend: Global AI/semiconductor volatility (Oracle, Dell, TSM, Lam Research) creates cross-asset uncertainty. Qantas strike vote threatens QAN.AX. Canva (CVA.AX) faces employee privacy legal risk.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational disruption risk; CVA.AX legal overhang. Global tech weakness dampens sentiment for ASX-listed tech names.

key_themes: RBA rate-hike risk vs stagflationary economy
Housing credit crisis and developer solvency
Commodity strength (coal, gold) offsetting broad market weakness

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike triggering housing correction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure; increase cash and short-duration bonds; hedge with gold (GSG.AX, GWN.AX)
Avoid speculative property developers; monitor construction sector (WTC.AX, GPT.AX) for supply-chain stress

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iran-US escalation spiking oil and inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Energy hedges via BHP.AX, WDS.AX; monitor AUD/USD for safe-haven flows
Reduce QAN.AX position; monitor Qantas strike vote outcome
Favour dividend-paying large caps (CBA.AX, BHP.AX, CSL.AX) over growth; avoid rate-sensitive small caps

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners and explorers on safe-haven demand and multiple discoveries
opportunities.rationale: Gateway, King River, Moonlight, PLC discoveries plus geopolitical risk support gold; 'distrust gold' narrative (#52) contrarian

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long on thermal coal exposure amid boom and merger catalyst
opportunities.rationale: Coal booms; Premier urging Chinese/Indian firm merger before funding stops creates M&A catalyst

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt to CSL.AX and WES.AX for earnings resilience
opportunities.rationale: Healthcare and staples provide stability amid rate-hike and housing stress

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure ahead of potential 10% house price decline
defensive_moves.rationale: Mortgage stress at 18-year highs; Bathla near collapse; fourth rate hike looms

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD downside and increase cash allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Oil-driven inflation may force RBA tightening, weakening AUD; global risk-off from Iran tensions

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid QAN.AX pending strike vote resolution
defensive_moves.rationale: Ground crew strike vote creates operational and earnings uncertainty

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure (1–3 months) as RBA rate-hike fears, oil-driven inflation, and housing stress dominate. Bond yield spike and mortgage stress cap upside. Gold and coal provide selective outperformance. Expect ^AXJO volatility 3–5% range.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious: per-capita recession risk, productivity deterioration, and housing correction weigh on broad market. However, commodity strength (coal, gold, LNG) and large-cap dividends (banks, miners) offer relative resilience. Structural decarbonisation (Chinese solar overtaking coal) is a medium-term headwind for thermal coal.

Iran-US geopolitical escalation and oil price trajectory
Australian CPI and retail sales data

Iron ore, thermal coal, gold spot prices
